description: This Kotlin source file defines a composable function 'HomeRail' which renders a UI component consisting of a title and a row of 'HomeCard' components, based on data from a 'RailSection'. It leverages Jetpack Compose libraries for layout and styling, and imports theme and model classes specific to the project.

methods.name: HomeRail
methods.description: A composable function that displays a section title and a row of cards representing items within a 'RailSection'. It arranges UI elements vertically, styles the title, and lays out the cards horizontally.
